part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `stringValueHubNormalizeRange` (src/t_string.c:963): negative `end` indexes that were still negative after adding the string length were clamped to 0, so `SUBSTR key 0 -500` returned the first character instead of an empty string.

The fix converts negative indexes first, then returns an empty range when `strlen == 0 || start >= strlen || end < 0 || start > end`, matching upstream Redis behavior (PR #12272).

Verified:
- `unit/type/string` test suite passes (including the new `getrange key 0 -100`, `-100 -99`, `-100 -101` edge cases)
- Manual repro confirms `substr test 1 -500` and `substr test 0 -500` now both return `""`, while normal ranges still work
